name: Melton Road carriageway and route
observations: Road runs from Taraj through brook/bridge retail stretch to the painted mini-roundabout.
Saved camera positions trace the captured route; roadway bends and width changes are visible.
White lane/parking/crossing markings, double-yellow kerb lines and local yellow boxes vary along the corridor.
Road is not a constant-width ruler-straight strip; reconstruct junction mouth and kerb changes first.
Vehicles obscure markings; compare overlapping forward/backward frames.
unknowns: Exact road centreline/width and Blender gameplay-scale conversion need calibration; GeoJSON camera path is not a survey centreline.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
placement_confidence: Approximate frontage marker derived from camera route, side and estimated offset; not a measured footprint.
